title: The Daily Grind – Espresso 100ML
description:
The Daily Grind – Espresso 100ML
Get ahead of the daily grind with an invigorating selection of coffee house vape juice. Every bit as creamy and delicious as the real thing, these fresh cafe-style flavours are developed in the UK, produced in Australia.
The Daily Grind Espresso Coffee vape juice is a perfect way to start your day. This Brazilian espresso is skillfully roasted and artfully blended to give you a strong dose of espresso coffee with a dash of frothy milk.
